We MUST hold Montana’s Senate seat

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2342%2E4032634%2E537G9j)
---
There's been an important update from Montana: **Jon Tester’s Senate race has been updated from “Toss-Up” to “Lean Republican” by Cook Political Report.** It’s an urgent reminder that we must do everything we can between now and November to help Jon Tester defend this seat and ensure Democrats maintain control of the Senate. [**There’s no time to waste — will you split a contribution right now to help Jon Tester win in Montana and support our efforts to hold our Senate majority? Any amount you can give will be put to immediate use and help win this critical state.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2693?t=8&akid=2342%2E4032634%2E537G9j)

**Jon Tester is one of just two Senate Democrats running in states that Trump won twice.**He is being targeted by Mitch McConnell and the GOP as a key race in their strategy to win back the Senate — and he needs every bit of support he can get to hold onto his seat. I am proud to have Jon Tester as my colleague. He is a true champion for Montanans and working families everywhere. He’s tough as nails, he cares about working people, and he’s got a heart bigger than the state of Montana. Senator Tester understands the needs of everyday Montanans down to his bones. He’s the only working farmer in the Senate, and he and his wife, Sharla, work on the same land that his grandparents tended more than 100 years ago. Recently, he led the effort to pass the PACT Act, which provides care and benefits to service members exposed to toxins, and he’s working to make sure the law delivers results. He knows what it means to represent working people in the Senate. [**Jon Tester needs your help to keep his seat and keep control of the Senate safely in Democratic hands. If there is any amount you can contribute right now to support his campaign and strengthen our chances to maintain Senate control, please chip in right now.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2693?t=14&akid=2342%2E4032634%2E537G9j) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

name: Voter Action Project
subject: Send Gavin Newson a message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091424_3&amount=25]
Folks, The danger is on the horizon:
Fake video, images, and audio — so-called “deepfakes” created by artificial intelligence (AI) — are becoming a major problem for elections around the world.
Just last month, Elon Musk shared a deepfake video of Kamala Harris in which a hyper-realistic but fake version of the Vice President degrades herself and calls herself a “deep state puppet.” Sadly, it was viewed more than 150 million times in a single week.
California has the opportunity to lead the nation against such deepfake manipulation of our elections by passing two groundbreaking bills . We need to let Gov. Newsom know that we need these passed.
Sign our petition now: Let Governor Gavin Newsom know the nation is watching and he needs to sign these now! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Need to know more about these bills? Here they are:
AB 2839 will ban deepfakes of candidates, elected officials, and elections officials in political advertising or other election communications that are reasonably likely to harm the reputation of candidates or undermine confidence in the outcome of the election for 120 days before an election and for 60 days after.
AB 2655 will require large online platforms to block or label such deepfakes when they get complaints about demonstrably untrue and provably false content meant to impermissibly influence our elections at peak election times.
We need to get these bills over the finish line so the rest of the country knows we're not going to stand for this kind of interference in our elections.
Add your name today: Tell Gavin Newsom to sign both AB 2655 and AB 2839 right away! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/ab2655-ab2839-coalition?source=sw-ab2655-ab2839-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

But while he's focused on rolling back our personal freedoms, **I’m committed to solving the issues that are _actually_ impacting Floridians, their lives, and their property. **
I've worked at the state and national level to **expand health care access to Americans** , **protect our seniors** who have worked their entire lives to earn their retirement, and deliver nearly **$10 million in essential FEMA funding** for South Florida communities impacted by Hurricane Irma. **Now, I'm fighting to save our pro-choice Senate majority so we can codify reproductive freedom nationwide. **
**But doing that starts with kicking out extremists standing in the way — and that includes Rick Scott.**

Floridians deserve someone better than a self-serving politician like Rick Scott — they deserve someone who listens to their concerns, takes those concerns to Washington, and fights to bring home solutions. Friend, I’ve spent my life in public service fighting to expand opportunities for every single American, and I've gotten to know the families who, like me, get to call Florida home. That’s how I know we need to restore abortion rights, protect Social Security and Medicare, and expand affordable health care — and why I’m running to defeat Rick Scott in November. = | | = Like you, I've had enough. I'm TIRED of him thinking he can get away with this, and I can’t imagine another six years of him in office. name: Nick Begich

body:
Pleased to share that the Alaska Republican Party has endorsed me! | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
## Republicans Unite to Win!
Dear Friends,

I’m thrilled to share some incredible news with you. This weekend, at the Alaska Republican Party's meeting in Fairbanks, I received their _**unanimous endorsement**_ for U.S. Congress! It’s a tremendous honor to have the full and exclusive support of Republicans across our great state, united in our vision for a stronger future for Alaska. The standing ovations I received from party members was truly humbling, and it’s a clear sign that we’re ready for change.

This endorsement sends a powerful message: Alaskans are ready for leadership that **shows up** , consistently **votes in our interests** , and fights for our right to responsibly develop our natural resources. I’m committed to being that leader. With your help, we can bring a fresh, commonsense approach to Washington—one that focuses on securing a prosperous future for our state and standing up for Alaskan families.

Now, more than ever, we need to come together as Republicans. The Democrats are rallying their forces, and they see us as a major threat. But with the full backing of the Alaska GOP and **your** support, I’m confident we can overcome the noise and elect a representative who will truly fight for Alaska’s future.

**This is just the beginning**. Let’s keep this momentum going! Together, we can make sure our conservative values are upheld, our resources are responsibly managed, and that Alaska’s best days are ahead.

Together, we can ensure a prosperous future for all Alaskans.

**America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Onward to victory,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress
\---

P.S. You might have noticed that the Alaska Democrats have been a little salty lately about their recent failures in court. The party's executive director [even went so far as to say](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=845f2324ba&e=6679001ba0) that I "clearly [know] that he has a snowball's chance in hell of winning." Well, one of my supporters took exception to that and put this graphic together. Let's just say that I like this snowball's chances!

P.P.S. If you haven’t already, please consider volunteering or donating to our campaign. Every bit of help makes a huge difference in ensuring that Alaskans have the representation they deserve. Visit [our website](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=d5c5f9bc6d&e=6679001ba0) to get involved!

You head to the store - _half-a-dozen Democrat signs are staring you in the face._

| | | |
# **How to Win Rural America: Fight the Dark Money**
---
| | | | MAGA has all the dark money in the world, but we cannot let that ruin our democracy. MAGA billionaires want to control the government, prioritize profits over people, and attack our institutions. To win this fight against dark money influencing our government, it will require an unprecedented grassroots effort. | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlanhp480i4vdqk346dgm3qqcjvt3surn8414ef0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c5g68or1c1h2bs)

Dear Friend, In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people. After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception." **As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now than ever that the United States stand with our ally. **Israel should be able to count on our support in its fight for its survival. **[Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zppmikio9lv4vsod4fg1k49iem80dnmf9a0eu8ag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c5g68or1c1h2bs)**

---
|
---
**To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:** It is of great importance that the next president of the United States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle East, Israel. For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel. Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas terrorists, this support has been put into question. Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a priority of the current chief executive and every presidential candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel. We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries. We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people and against alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise. We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

Dear Friend, In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people. After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception." **As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now than ever that the United States stand with our ally. **Israel should be able to count on our support in its fight for its survival. **[Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=78fb4e122d1d46a9967d63bbca8970dd&_e=8WSe3-SpK5JiUKNzGyGOxh4ipumKIMMaENuNrwd2nbyTcnwsrAHvQk_aqEB356RlNMJQkEJS__5dKdwMMvIvxOKFDn7czQGN6iRyg0zzSK5uQ4n74Savt5yEQag3oe3YLOr1kN_g1mch8mAnS1PKRajU9NE0veK45xT6Nu-FafmHaqsKQUyuA1fNnUJRNRVaoqx-UVYS7HXjFYAobhrP3w%3D%3D)**

**To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:** It is of great importance that the next president of the United States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle East, Israel. For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel. Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas terrorists, this support has been put into question. Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a priority of the current chief executive and every presidential candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel. We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries. We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people and against alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise. We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals just handed a critical victory to January 6 peaceful protesters and their families.

The Court ruled that a "geofence" warrant used by police to collect people's cell phone location and more without probable cause is ILLEGAL.

You see, Joe Biden's FBI used "geofence" warrants to spy on, harass, and arrest innocent Americans who peacefully protested at the US Capitol on January 6, 2021.

**This new ruling provides crucial legal support for all January 6 peaceful protesters, including my client, Jesus Rivera.**

Jesus is a US Marine combat veteran and patriot.

On January 6, 2021, Jesus peacefully recorded the events at the Capitol building in Washington, D.C. He shot video on his smart phone and a digital camera for a local news station back home in Florida.

He didn't protest or attack police.

He only shot video to provide for his wife and kids, and entered the Capitol peacefully like many other patriots that day.

**But around 7:30 AM on January 20, 2021, up to 20 heavily armed FBI agents raided his home with guns drawn. They had no probable cause, and their search warrant was obtained through lies, even outright fraud.**

Jesus was forcefully handcuffed, then moved to the FBI building.

His wife asked for the warrant several times, but didn't receive it until after the FBI agents finished searching their home.

**Jesus survived rocket attacks and exploding roadside bombs trying to bring freedom to Iraq and Afghanistan. But his freedom gets trampled on right here at home by out-of-control FBI agents!**

Can you imagine being treated like that?

Then leftist District Judge Colleen Collar-Kottelly sentenced Jesus to 8 MONTHS in federal prison!

(Let me tell you, she's the absolute worst judge I've appeared before in 45 years.)

Well, Jesus is out of prison now.

And I've filed a class action lawsuit for him and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent update.

**This crucial lawsuit can PROVE that FBI Director Christopher Wray, Attorney General Merrick Garland, the FBI and other agencies carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE on January 6 patriots. That means their convictions can be THROWN OUT. Their trials can be STOPPED.**

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 47 years.

You've seen me on cable TV news and heard me on talk radio.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And let me tell you, my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.**

Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court!

As you know, many January 6 patriots have been brutally abused and tortured waiting for trial. Many others suffer in prison right now, far from their families and friends.

## Investigation Reveals Secret Service Failures
An internal investigation has revealed multiple failures in the Secret Service's protection of former President Trump before his attempted assassination in July. In addition to [breakdowns in communication](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQRb8GdxPBwAtOQbGNu7ftltEExjG7xFgwtpW_X2Xr7a50pSOd8-v7_k255PX5k14cZK53ipIPvt_AfAG6uxtSmJmR7cDBeLw6PXo_Dkvw1rjRWuuN8ex9wlFrxitHcyP78OOQA2p0-ma-jNbe4sWy1w55ti7RTA-jnOaUpbbL75pXWXgu73pwu8T6GkpYRLau7A-Fk8JpfW-1y-dSOH3ACid9UziZz9o7rHx2hVPn2FigcztyZJgpF04gFXjte2PoNPNzp5Y6nNwY8gpbochAAtL219ZhI2hUyhtkIYFY95JgoYPhUWr8wwn6Uqtw63BkPqHxVpsonIYW0nbmUnK_euX080W5_JOR_6c9Av4NAAD__2GwfS8), the probe found that agents failed to ensure safeguards that would [obscure the view from the rooftop](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHO2yAQAOCnwRsWYGLsgaFS5e3vkkodozOc42swRHCJlbfv0vF_g0_fn6_bF1CifP8FB3reyg0C0xtvs9QXaezNdtFviAaHDr12ZrRqcm7qdg9wmS-I82RHNa7K6dECRkAMqKbVrR15o4xVs75opdxg-gGdsga3wUbYYNXCKozEpfZ_C2XecUuf8sbah3J0ye_MzyaGH8IswiznefYRKH0OoNSH0r8ewiwZzybMApUpJJR6mOysZy3Mct1LeFC-y4gMlJpsGF6V-CPXivCI5cxNAjMeT8YooTVojTIwlSx_lgwpyt_1dTzlFUNFllesbwrY73ykrvr4PCklaqMTVt3_o46Ov098e_MvAAD__57WeGQ) location from which shooter Thomas Crooks fired on Trump. Secret Service also never instructed local police to secure the roof leading up to the rally.
## Russia Threatens West Over Missile Decision

Friend: On International Day of Democracy — a day meant to encourage governments to strengthen democracy — I think it's important to remind ourselves of what's at stake this November.
The future of our American democracy hangs in the balance — and that's no exaggeration. At a recent Turning Point Action convention, Donald Trump said, _"In four years, you don't have to vote again. We'll have it fixed so good, you're not gonna have to vote."_
Our elections are an integral part of what makes us a democracy. Our government is, and should be, elected by the people, for the people. We research our candidates, head to the ballot box on Election Day, and vote for who we believe will best represent us and move our country forward.
But Donald Trump wants to get rid of that. And Rick Scott, his equally dangerous partner in crime (literally), is no better.

Trump incited a deadly attack on the U.S. Capitol, undermining the very foundation of our democracy. But even after that, Rick Scott refuses to separate himself from Trump and his antidemocratic beliefs.

Instead, he supported Trump's baseless claims of voter fraud and voted to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election. He even attacked our American legal system after jurors found Trump guilty on 34 felony counts.
He's proven time and again that he'll put Trump's needs and his own needs above the needs of the American people. And by endorsing the Trump-Vance ticket, he's also putting a rubber stamp on their Project 2025 agenda — a plan that will roll back reproductive rights, repeal the Affordable Care Act, and gut Medicare and Social Security.

**I came to the United States to find a better life. But now, we're at risk of leaving our country in the hands of wannabe dictators and corrupt politicians. There's only one way for us to save our democracy from corrupt politicians, friend — and that's by voting on Election Day (while we still can) and protecting our Senate majority.**

subject: Access “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
---
| | Dear Friend,C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._yBfKAaQ)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-PnxyCLkqN74QAb845-g).

Warm Regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.
Executive Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:
Another four years of a Trump presidency is a terrifying prospect.
---
Derek, a recent New York Times poll shows a deadlock in the presidential race. Take a look: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240915_1353_fr&refcode2=1353_22930333_bCgbVm&akid=1353%2E22930333%2EbCgbVm) This election is going to be _close_ , and with just 51 days until Election Day, we’re focused on reaching as many voters as possible. By now, you’ve probably heard that the DNC is spending millions of dollars reaching voters in battleground states like Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. Take a look: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240915_1353_fr&refcode2=1353_22930333_bCgbVm&akid=1353%2E22930333%2EbCgbVm) But of course, we aren’t just focused on swing states. To win key races this fall, we have to compete _everywhere_. We have to reach as many voters as possible and make sure they have a plan to cast ballots for Democrats. You might be wondering, “How do we do this?” and the answer is simple: with your support. When you make a contribution to the DNC, we’re able to take your donation and invest it strategically where it’s needed most. **We like to call these investments “nested opportunities.”** These investments allow us to strengthen our largest-ever voter protection program, expand our successful on-the-ground and virtual organizing efforts, reach and persuade undecided voters, and make sure as many Democrats as possible have a plan to make their voices heard in this election. And in all honesty, a donation now -- rather than in the days before Election Day -- will have a **multiplier effect** , where your impact can be doubled or even tripled. By pitching in today, you’ll help us make sure we’ve got the resources not only to help elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz but to win key races down the ballot, too. [**So, Derek, what do you say? Can we count on you to make a $3 investment in the DNC’s work to reach voters across the country?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240915_1353_fr&refcode2=1353_22930333_bCgbVm&akid=1353%2E22930333%2EbCgbVm) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20240915_1353_fr&refcode2=1353_22930333_bCgbVm&akid=1353%2E22930333%2EbCgbVm)**

Look, Trump’s attacked me a few times now. Every time he comes down to Arizona he singles me out, and this last visit was no different.
#

Peter
Look, Trump’s attacked me a few times now. Every time he comes down to Arizona he singles me out, and this last visit was no different.
He called me weak, and Kari Lake strong. And... honestly, from Trump himself, I was expecting the material to be a bit better. That’s all you got, Donald?
I guess Trump’s idea of strength is supporters who call for political violence on his behalf. Who tell their followers they need to “strap on a glock” to go to vote. Apparently strength is having court case after court case thrown out because there isn’t a shred of evidence behind your election lies.
My idea of strength is my mom, raising me and my three sisters on a secretary's salary. It’s my teachers, spending their time helping a kid with no money and no connections get into Harvard. It’s the guys I went out on patrol with in al Anbar, Iraq.
Strength, to me, is taking a stand to defend our democracy. Like you have, Peter. It means a lot to have you on this team.
And with my mid-month fundraising deadline coming up at midnight tonight, with our last, official FEC deadline before the election coming after that, it would mean more than I can say if you could make a donation to support my campaign.

### **1.[Pennsylvania counties must examine election process improvements ahead of 2024 general elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2685670d31&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_From The Editors_
Act 77, the 2019 law that revolutionized Pennsylvania’s elections and ushered in mail-in voting, has made the elections process in the commonwealth like that of a river after a flood: the cause of the roiling might be over, but the sediment has not yet settled back down, and much of the water remains unclear.

This is the unsteady situation the commonwealth finds itself in as we are now barrelling towards the 2024 election, one in which Pennsylvanians’ votes will likely decide the presidency. As of this publishing, the website RealClearPolitics.com averages several polls which show former President Trump tied with Vice President Kamala Harris in Pennsylvania — the most narrow margin of any swing state.

If Pennsylvania is decided by less than one percent as it was in 2016, we guarantee there will be a new hurricane of scrutiny as partisans look for advantages.

**Why It Matters**. Our investigation shows that the system has become too opaque and overly complex given the divided nature of our electorate. Elements of standardization are desperately needed.

County officials and election directors are operating in an era in which not one but two objectives are paramount: conduct an election in which all legally cast votes are correctly counted, and also carry out the first objective in such a transparent manner that when a curious public examines the methods, means, and actions of the election officials, the public at large will have little choice but to be satisfied with the results.

Today, too many voters are skeptical. And discerning readers may be forgiven if, upon reading this report, they are confused, or otherwise unsatisfied with its conclusions. Therein lies the problem, we now have a system that is not sufficiently open or verifiable, which undermines the integrity of the voting process regardless of the efficacy of any counting process.

But, there is hope, because enough lessons have been learned in recent years to make these two democracy-defining objectives a reality.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6f7f28ff69&e=b7b3eddce2)

|
---
|
### **2.[Christine Flowers: Young, urban — and Republican?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=65f4197970&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Christine Flowers_
Tuesday night found me in an unusual place: surrounded by passionate conservatives gathered to cheer on the Republican presidential candidate at a debate watch.

Evan Bochetto, son of my friend and legendary attorney George Bochetto and a member of the Philadelphia Young Republicans, had reached out a few days earlier to invite me to an event held at Hotel Monaco in Society Hill, a few hundred yards from the site of the presidential debate. When I arrived, I was ushered into a standing room only venue packed with Gen Z and Millennial voters enjoying food, drinks and eager to view the debate in two large television screens that had been set up in the hotel’s Lafayette Room.

But even more surprising than the number of attendees which I would put at close to 500 was the composition of the crowd: this 62-year-old columnist was by far one of the oldest women in the room. The vast majority of the female attendees were about half my age.

**Why It Matters**. I addressed the elephant in the room: Kamala Harris. I asked Chelsea, Allyson and Shannon how they felt about the Vice President being a woman and whether this had any impact on their vote. To a person, they stated that it was insulting to believe that women will vote for a woman simply because of her gender. As Shannon said, “It’s pandering.”

This is a theme that I’ve heard from other women, not just Gen Z and millennials. When I was on an Inside Story panel a few weeks ago, the subject of the “suburban woman vote” was broached at the table, and the two women at the table, myself and Laura Manion, had to remind the male panelists that we do not vote as a monolith and that, no, abortion is not the litmus test for the majority of educated voters.

# **5\. What we're reading**
The ABC moderators in Tuesday’s debate were bad. But were they so bad that they killed the entire concept of a presidential debate? It’s quite possible, [Emily Jashinksky wrote this week for _UnHerd_](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6203b2a7bc&e=b7b3eddce2). The CNN debate in June saw moderators Jake Tapper and Dana Bash act with impressive even-handedness. ABC’s decision to “factcheck” in real time — and only for one candidate — destroyed for conservatives whatever trust Tapper and Bash had earned in a mainstream media organization’s ability to run a fair contest.

_The New York Times_ profiled two top DLCC Spotlight candidates in their pursuit of breaking Republicans’ stronghold in the legislature and restoring the Democratic governor’s veto power. [**Learn more here →**](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMX9MtCCMWFxMDt5y22AkPIj2OKBqgE05JRoGJ14qHSvxMqokW0zEGV0RLpbECPSbtbjdJOXhWoPp8IPTIyZZn97r3jpPWvDTk7UUtzl6A561GT6ZQJRFxSioUV8P9LbZg_DCVHDCQuYZZ5iw9cnpN8MqR8v8EGgQpti2N-_Tb19oPn5Aam334khBa-l8U_BurNJxY6WRPDXd7vm_kzermJWalkJjEBDh6dJegcTQC8l0mqUHaWX-rcp3lZcoa0mmnJ1iA-8ASAVU-UJ-YBm7bK64lZC7pc9t_Pv1sjL9gpROLoGWIchY2uDOlkoUZiIG0KKFf_-DROW_PZSzfuLBfjfV6XCDZhv27eARjX9uSep3inYI56AnysN2zJD6YUgPi8PvM3tUdBlQw-fONQAb-24Zne727PzPCz0h42B8f9u-GziwuA0x40RA74eeh3Mt88nZcFMocX_L9RYFvWNHA-025_JfRjriIe-8VwWe79Rn7R2j6ZanDr9ejlr1je0F0IQP5BUEZGvzlJQQe1UYHJUO8MytzGbLO1cmMTUs0IuBBbeU2cbpn1OP2Souc2YF_211tPreUWzGb9nrd_0AL5rpUa7ArjTsyGsviGSMXFNA/49s/x2Bsl4AoREiI5Zo21nnN_g/h2/h001.CXGo1neJ8lNWOBZrkr5A124L8zuj__pJI8BY-MXheck)

[**Will you represent your community in our poll and share your thoughts on Tuesday’s debate? →**](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hW5Lkp5lOCwikP-XCX5D9XT00i77ntUaiJMKKXJvQMCeLfGpnsCi8g1CiwgqX0oEuvtdUdN4IbNmDDQhaup35PRk12TWzlJho2nOYm8qJRwAfJQkNliiBYifhWxJ_kN2TXKK6vUURhx2i7mtNWGn9fUg94V5gwFCat92no3I-1w8lx7IiDaXqZaZJs0kN-fib40_3ypjdxiE_mHR0pkxa_PnZzzfU4TmW8aSU-_ETsKrr98O_GtXHCPYzHK655XCWE1Pk6-JCNxdo8yWuQe3vDvXbJVjJFAWUMzCZRVJYQC3BybHg053K2vqSLv8ytvCHAMnrql2cd6Ah9s-GxR4rVVN2qvuOMy67FmbPrDS4iO0K2aaUBnscYj27V3d1fdeGeK91vPmTTV_r_4KcPfmzFsVFOFOP4rCWL2_FwgvGhCx_A7alwiBkB5EpXPcb5ZSzDsw1qmrBVdKTRH_FQELkCQrMczZGSMLBqzGnXwN8LmBSYG6E8ne1dpxThKkdkFpeqg/49s/x2Bsl4AoREiI5Zo21nnN_g/h3/h001.7D8EeZfqyMRvD3MIZl2a4DgY2CwTqySeQHjypBmUiVY)

body:
Team Hudson is working hard every day to ensure MI-3 returns to responsive representation focused on positive and tangible actions not platitudes and words. This has been a busy week for us.
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BZC5D-tiIKW1zvsqacNY3Ry-6v0xIOYioyalswUpoAMbHR-X81Wo_rAk-Nr_f65o1fJ96ql-A9h32S6Q4lVd4XAhpWTafzJiCcBqihfyFnK-FVujRKisEYS69KpPKcHPiL8FIe71mAn9lBxL8_z13D5XyF0xAUGokw5kanUUtD0=&c=U3gWoTdTxo1hxfeO9mHGY8SCXIuByhAV6IHvY2QytX0cWoexbDMysg==&ch=rg4Lz-XxJrkeZLgKmRhWdAC1MJefT5Zq81Yge8MJzI68BBodfbEP6w==)
---
|
Friend

It has been another busy week for Team Hudson! We've been working hard throughout the district, talking to voters, and discussing policies that will actually make West Michiganders' lives better.
We've seen Hillary Scholten continue to play the same tired playbook: Saying nice middle-of-the-road things about bipartisanship, but then voting party-line with her progressive base 96% OF THE TIME. The numbers don't lie. With Hillary, the record doesn't match the rhetoric.
If you are tired of this same old song and dance and want a better path for your future, read below for ways to help Paul win on November 5.
---
|
### Talking to Voters Around MI-3

This week we covered the full span of the district - talking about the need for better leadership in Washington to tackle serious problems like inflation, soaring debt, and security threats both at home and abroad.
We had the pleasure of bringing this message to a great group of voters in Muskegon County, the West Michigan Policy Forum, and a wonderful group of seniors at the Breton Woods of Holland Home.

---
|
### Reflecting on Grandpa Duffy's Legacy

Saturday was a special day at Spartan Stadium. Paul's grandfather Duffy Daugherty was the football coach at Michigan State from 1954-72, and this weekend his 1965 and 1966 national championship teams were officially inducted into the MSU Hall of Fame. These pathbreaking teams were special not only because of their success on the field, but also because they paved the way for the future as the first truly racially integrated teams anywhere in the nation in college football.
Paul's grandfather was instrumental in righting the wrongness of segregated college sports, and victory on the field was all the more special because of those actions. What an honor it was to spend time with members of that historic group! Go Green!

We've been working hard throughout the district, talking to voters, and discussing policies that will actually make West Michiganders' lives better. We've seen Hillary Scholten continue to play the same tired playbook: Saying nice middle-of-the-road things about bipartisanship, but then voting party-line with her progressive base 96% OF THE TIME. The numbers don't lie. With Hillary, the record doesn't match the rhetoric. If you are tired of this same old song and dance and want a better path for your future, read below for ways to help Paul win on November 5. | Talking to Voters Around MI-3 This week we covered the full span of the district - talking about the need for better leadership in Washington to tackle serious problems like inflation, soaring debt, and security threats both at home and abroad. We had the pleasure of bringing this message to a great group of voters in Muskegon County, the West Michigan Policy Forum, and a wonderful group of seniors at the Breton Woods of Holland Home. | == | == | == | Reflecting on Grandpa Duffy's Legacy Saturday was a special day at Spartan Stadium. Paul's grandfather Duffy Daugherty was the football coach at Michigan State from 1954-72, and this weekend his 1965 and 1966 national championship teams were officially inducted into the MSU Hall of Fame. These pathbreaking teams were special not only because of their success on the field, but also because they paved the way for the future as the first truly racially integrated teams anywhere in the nation in college football. Paul's grandfather was instrumental in righting the wrongness of segregated college sports, and victory on the field was all the more special because of those actions. # Who is Peter Hernandez?
---
[](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=056a451cb4&e=638e6c2751)
| A first-generation American, Peter Hernandez has lived the American dream. His first job was picking apricots in our Central Valley along side his large Mexican family. He knows the value of hard work and appreciates the working class American family.
A father of 4, he is a strong advocate for family values, parental rights, and keeping the government out of the business of parenting our children. This sentiment drove him to run for election as school board trustee, where he saw first-hand the ever-increasing and alarming role the government is taking in raising kids.
As a county supervisor, Peter stood up against the power-hungry political class who sought only to lock people down with no regard for the damage being done. A strong voice against the dangers of COVID lockdowns, he took the fight to dictatorial county personnel, pushing back on bad government policies.
Having built a successful small business, he knows the goodness of hard labor instead of unfulfilling government handouts that serve to create a class of victims instead of providing opportunities for upward mobility.
As a business owner, he’s met a payroll. He’s dealt with the massive regulatory burden required by the government and sees a lot of opportunity for right-sizing these demands.
No elite, unlike his opponent, he has no interest in being a career politician. His plan is to get in, represent his people in creating opportunities and downsizing the government, and then head back home to his small business.**Come meet him. And bring your questions. Here are 4 opportunities coming up, and look online for more.**

His first job was picking apricots in our Central Valley along side his large Mexican family. He knows the value of hard work and appreciates the working class American family. A father of 4, he is a strong advocate for family values, parental rights, and keeping the government out of the business of parenting our children. This sentiment drove him to run for election as school board trustee, where he saw first-hand the ever-increasing and alarming role the government is taking in raising kids. As a county supervisor, Peter stood up against the power-hungry political class who sought only to lock people down with no regard for the damage being done. A strong voice against the dangers of COVID lockdowns, he took the fight to dictatorial county personnel, pushing back on bad government policies. Having built a successful small business, he knows the goodness of hard labor instead of unfulfilling government handouts that serve to create a class of victims instead of providing opportunities for upward mobility. All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://trk.secureandprosper._nfOkkg_Oz4g)

And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://trk.secureandprosper.)** Thanks for considering standing with us. In just a moment, I'm going to ask you to **[make a $3 contribution to our people-powered re-election campaign for Congress.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-sep24.dwuT-F&refcode=em240915-1&t=2&akid=1340%2E791427%2EpqrDVw)** But before I do, I'm hoping you'll give me a chance to explain why your support is so important.
Here's the situation:
September is an especially big month for campaigns across the country, and a major reason for that is the official FEC fundraising deadline at the end of it.
Once this deadline passes, we're _legally required_ to report our fundraising numbers for the year so far. That means disclosing the amount of money we've raised, and how many individual contributions make up that total. Publicly. For everyone to see. Good or bad, no matter what.

body:
You know Josh Hawley. He’s the guy who went viral for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.”
#
Hi Peter, I’m Lucas Kunce — the 13-year Marine veteran, antitrust advocate, and born-and-raised Missourian running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
You know Josh Hawley. He’s the guy who went viral for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.” Or maybe you might recognize him better from his actions on January 6th, 2021...
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)**
This email is long. But I wanted to take a moment today to reintroduce myself and tell you more about the historic opportunity we have to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for real Missourians this year. **Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all.
I want to codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done.
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team.[Please add a donation of any amount right now so we can continue building this movement and finally give power back to everyday, working people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=9&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=10&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=11&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=12&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
---
I’m not just running to make a point — **this is a race we can win.**
Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis. **And this year, with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban going on the ballot, we expect even more voters to turn out and protect their freedoms this November.**
So if we’re able to communicate to voters that our campaign is about taking back power for real Missourians, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley.
**But I need you on this team to get it done, Peter.** National insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign are spending millions to air false attacks about me — and over the coming weeks, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That’s why we need the resources to fight back and deliver our positive message to voters.
**[Will you chip in anything you can right now so we can keep building this record-breaking grassroots movement? I don’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big difference to our campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=15&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=16&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=17&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=18&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=19&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71650?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=20&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71649?refcode=em20240915-7657&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)
---
Together, we can take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and finally put real, everyday people in charge of our country.
Thanks for helping us get it done,
Lucas Kunce

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240915-7657-footer&t=22&refcode2=7657_614464_BbMNMa&akid=7657%2E614464%2EBbMNMa)**

body:
He will sign a national abortion ban into law.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92863854/498557010/684588316?refcode=EM_F_240915bans_N_TB_90DO_4_NG_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDA2OWRmYS02ZTczLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OnHk1cZ9a3Vrg9mReuiuXAEoO2_wEd885B1_V3usBCg=) Peter,

In over 20 states, there are Trump abortion bans that have ZERO exceptions for rape in incest. This is only the beginning. During Tuesday’s debate, former president and convicted felon Donald Trump **REFUSED** to answer the question of whether or not he would sign a national abortion ban into law, **__making it clear that he would.__**

They tried to strip away abortion access in Ohio, and voters showed up to enshrine their freedoms in the state constitution. In fact, in every place where abortion was left up to the people, they made their voices clear: **abortion rights are human rights.**

**YOUNG DEMOCRATS DENOUNCE DONALD TRUMP & JD VANCE'S RECKLESS AND DANGEROUS ATTACKS ON HAITIAN AMERICANS**
---
**WASHINGTON, D.C.** — Donald Trump and JD Vance’s rhetoric has always been extreme and an affront to the values our nation stands for. In recent days, their spreading of baseless, racist conspiracy theories about Haitian Americans—and people of color more broadly—has proven once again that they aren’t fighting to make America great; they’re fighting to make it white. Make no mistake—if Donald Trump returns to the Oval Office, his administration won’t stop at just hateful rhetoric. They will carry out attacks on immigrants and communities of color. Trump's "Project 2025" already calls for denaturalizing American citizens and deporting legal immigrants he deems ‘unfit’. This authoritarian plan directly calls to increase barriers to naturalization and advocates for the government to keep “continuous vetting and investigations” over legal immigrants. No real problem facing Americans is solved by inciting a racist mob against vulnerable communities people striving for the American Dream. What America needs is a President who will fight for common sense immigration reform, without the bigotry and hate Republican nominees are championing. America needs Kamala Harris.
---

Fellow patriot,

The stakes in Ohio have never been higher.

My friend **Bernie Moreno** is running to defeat **Sherrod Brown** — a liberal who has stood in the way of putting America First for far too long.

## **The problem**
Medicare won't approve or pay for FDA approved obesity meds. This is particularly harming senior citizens who cannot afford their needed medications.
## **Our solution**
Email Congress and demand they pass the bipartisan bill requiring Medicare to cover the cost of these meds. Hola todos,
Today officially kicks off **Hispanic Heritage Month** , where we highlight the cultural and societal impact millions of hispanos have had in the United States. Though our backgrounds may span seas, regions, and even continents, we can still come together and celebrate!
From tacos to tostones, we all celebrate in our own way, and I am proud to be hispana.
Did you know in Texas we make up over **40%** of the population?? As the second-largest group of voting-age Americans, _we always show up for our communities_. When it’s time to vote for our next president, **80% of latino voters show up**. The fact is: We’re here and we care about our rights and our freedoms.
But especially now, when we’re weeks away from voting in the most important election of our lives — we need to stand together.
[Since George W. Bush became president, the number of Hispanic voters has _doubled_ and continues to rise every year. During this Hispanic Heritage Month, can we count on you to pledge to vote this November?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92869741/498575885/120075768?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYzA5NzdkYS03YTczLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rPcGlBgwpidIY3dt89bxPXCBm5ewJ9BRh4OqD-aEUY0=&emci=b6e75495-2c72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fc0977da-7a73-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=6787172)

clean_body: | Hola todos, Today officially kicks off Hispanic Heritage Month , where we highlight the cultural and societal impact millions of hispanos have had in the United States. Though our backgrounds may span seas, regions, and even continents, we can still come together and celebrate! From tacos to tostones, we all celebrate in our own way, and I am proud to be hispana. Did you know in Texas we make up over 40% of the population?? As the second-largest group of voting-age Americans, we always show up for our communities. When it’s time to vote for our next president, 80% of latino voters show up. The fact is: We’re here and we care about our rights and our freedoms. But especially now, when we’re weeks away from voting in the most important election of our lives — we need to stand together. | Juntos y unidos, Cynthia Carrizales State Press Secretary NextGen America | | = |

Peter — I know my
team and I have been reaching out a lot about my reelection race, so today
I want to tell you about my very first campaign:

When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin in 1997, no one thought I could
win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the
race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said,
“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s
going to be tough."

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

The next thing I said was this: I believe that women have to run —
especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we
get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to
the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last
time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring
over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won.

I’m used to being written off,
Peter. But time and again,
grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. The battle to
protect my seat this year will be no different, with this race being my
toughest election yet.

Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $43
million to buy this seat, and recent polls are showing this race
statistically tied. Protecting this seat won’t be easy, but together, I
know we can defy the odds once again.

Peter,
A couple days ago, we sent out an email that you may have missed with this wild news: barely a week after posting an Instagram video calling Jill Stein and the Green Party “not authentic” and “predatory”, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez took to X (formerly Twitter) on Thursday to attack Jill and Greens **_again_**. AOC tweeted that “Jill Stein hasn’t won so much as a bingo game” and that Jill and Greens don’t care enough about people to “organize, build power and infrastructure, and win” - while her own “democratic” party is actively suing us in multiple states to try to prevent us from doing those very things! Jill lit up the Internet by pushing back against AOC for [lying from the DNC stage about Kamala Harris “working tirelessly for a ceasefire”](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PFt0RQJG8CjCGB0W6jg0LG-pmkYeT4NN2KK09BEs9O5xYosDGN9zHMQkC2JFFjSKMNqtkF-CfVq0PT0aVrSDDA&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aoc_resend_9_15&n=1) and for [refusing to use her position to fight for the issues she claimed to care about](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PFt0RQJG8CjCGB0W6jg0LG-pmkYeT4NN2KK09BEs9O6UkjVHP2ILo8SkspWBGIBTylMQz0NFJkD7qgN06c7xVQ&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aoc_resend_9_15&n=2):
---
---
---
While in her initial Instagram video AOC claimed to be a critic of the 2-party system, she has refused to engage with Jill’s response calling on her to join a public conversation about expanding our democracy. Instead, AOC appears to be using her social media platforms for coordinated attacks on Jill with DNC operatives like Keith Edwards and Lis Smith, who is leading a well-funded DNC operation to attack challengers outside the 2-party system. Apparently AOC is set on pushing her anti-Green talking points, based on her refusal to acknowledge the facts about how Greens are working to build people power - and how _her own party_ is going all out to stop us:
---
---
With AOC’s repeated attacks on Jill, more and more people are noticing how she seems to have much more interest in smearing our grassroots people-powered campaign than challenging the corrupt political establishment:
---
---
---
---
Peter, it’s clear to us why the anti-Democratic Party keeps attacking Jill and Greens: they’re terrified that we **_are_** building the critical mass we need to “organize, build power and infrastructure, and win.” And the **_last_** thing they want is a real multi-party democracy where voters like _**you**_ have a real choice. [**If you’re outraged by these malicious and disingenuous attacks and want to show the political elites that they’re not going to stop us, please pitch in whatever you can today to help Jill and Butch run campaign ads across the country to get out our message and get out the vote!**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aoc_resend_9_15&n=3)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: I could be the first. But I need your help to do it, Derek.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help.
Derek, Arizona is about 33% Latino. If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate.
I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. **[If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a split donation of $5 with John Fetterman to help us win this race?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240915?refcode=em20240915-9378&refcode2=9378_434096_z-YtY5&akid=9378%2E434096%2Ez-YtY5)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240915?amount=5&refcode=em20240915-9378&refcode2=9378_434096_z-YtY5&akid=9378%2E434096%2Ez-YtY5)**
Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college.
But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard.
I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq.
I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate.
Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way.

I'm in the fight of my life to defeat extremist Republican Rick Scott and become the first Latina Senator in Florida.
| | |
---
Friend,

Today marks the beginning of Hispanic Heritage Month — a month-long celebration of Hispanic and Latino history and culture. It’s a holiday that I, as a proud Latina from Ecuador, take pride in celebrating.
As I think about the Latinos who have immigrated to the United States and made an impact on our country, big or small, I can't help but think about the Latinas who have impacted my own life, specifically my mother and sisters.

My mom brought me and my sisters to the United States from Ecuador for a chance at a better life. She knew it would be a difficult transition, leaving behind our home and moving to a new country thousands of miles away — and she was right. But she did it so my sisters and I could have our very own American Dreams.
It didn't come easy, friend. There were many long hours and lots of hard work to make ends meet in those early years, but the opportunities I was given here allowed me to go from a minimum-wage job to becoming the first South American immigrant in Congress.
**Now, I'm in the fight of my life to defeat extremist Republican Rick Scott and become the first Latina senator from Florida.**
Rick Scott is coming after my own community to turn its people against me — he's spending millions on Spanish-language ads, and he's resorted to calling me a "socialista." On top of that, he continues to spread conspiracies about our elections, casting doubt on the most sacred cornerstone of our democracy.

Having grown up under a dictatorship before coming to the U.S., I don't take these attacks lightly. I've said it before, and I'll say it again: **Freedom isn’t some political slogan for me.**

And that's how Rick Scott is using it.

**But guess what? His feeble attempts to undermine me won't work. Whether he is****lying about his stance on reproductive rights or threatening to roll back affordable health care,****Floridians up and down the state have caught on to his frauds and schemes — and they're fed up.**
Like other Latino immigrants, my mother brought me and my sisters to this country so that I could have the kinds of opportunities and freedoms she never did. Today, it’s that very freedom that Rick Scott and his ultra-wealthy, far-right friends want to take away.

This is the FINAL WEEK before the first votes are cast, and the stakes couldn't be higher.

Not only are Democrats launching relentless attack ads and pouring massive amounts of money into Pennsylvania, _**but the latest CNN poll shows my race is DEADLOCKED --46%-46%.**_

This is how fiercely competitive and crucial this race has become. With just a few days until the first votes and fewer than 60 until Election Day, **[every single dollar counts.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6b6983358ead43f38ab8f1535f4ba4c0&_e=8L_mmWlU0hCZxduoMO0jDMziuCJRVmhCNGxt4P2U99owhFDlfSOSDjCpdKw0ddi75u4BURajv_CSBz6YxPCytoBefVzjKev-13pxHk0yYRSZ612mZ3k7PT7DdZdMVpgRO9-mVOaqDOm265lhR5FCWfUZ1j2lM1AamzyXsDWR_4VS7DvUzmc7o7498AO0RbFeH1l5xKWsfF60hYFqgsmQ8G08pnNhA9E2Rt_98nGyhERKEc04IoTOdvm6aZMMpekBswfo5YZtyYlcDYPq31_aA9BS7fAxeoMgZXflPRzSoq1oGdEcDP_jx1Ky1IKaS6xZ5TT7pyg3HWfgxHmfNxRGgn7KtryiWqr2TeadKdOqOxqLb-KBl3v6Sf02Gaon7dVM)**

Now, I'm fighting in the #1 battleground race that will determine the Senate majority. I'm in this race because Pennsylvanians deserve better than Bob Casey--_a rubber stamp for Harris ' failed liberal agenda._ Pennsylvanians deserve a leader who will secure the border, bring down costs, and fight for them every single day.

But I can't win this without your help.

Grassroots support from patriots like you is the backbone of our campaign. **[That's why I'm asking for your urgent donation right now.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6b6983358ead43f38ab8f1535f4ba4c0&_e=8L_mmWlU0hCZxduoMO0jDMziuCJRVmhCNGxt4P2U99owhFDlfSOSDjCpdKw0ddi75u4BURajv_CSBz6YxPCytoBefVzjKev-13pxHk0yYRSZ612mZ3k7PT7DdZdMVpgRO9-mVOaqDOm265lhR5FCWfUZ1j2lM1AamzyXsDWR_4VS7DvUzmc7o7498AO0RbFeH1l5xKWsfF60hYFqgsmQ8IzY9fJSXY6oNwbIS61p9JqU0hpMuTLSlfSyPDa1SpFnTkI_Hg9r3I0ZGJv177HkFJjneV64JAza_FDw9S969IHt0BBvMiu_dOI8RvhDoiFr6C8GMqp2hDvDKWu3YZo4o2-gD-swwT9qIKyOO8c10CPLs8BPAEJnGSVPIivQHb9s)**

**[So please, chip in anything you can to support my campaign today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6b6983358ead43f38ab8f1535f4ba4c0&_e=8L_mmWlU0hCZxduoMO0jDMziuCJRVmhCNGxt4P2U99owhFDlfSOSDjCpdKw0ddi75u4BURajv_CSBz6YxPCytoBefVzjKev-13pxHk0yYRSZ612mZ3k7PT7DdZdMVpgRO9-mVOaqDOm265lhR5FCWfUZ1j2lM1AamzyXsDWR_4VS7DvUzmc7o7498AO0RbFeH1l5xKWsfF60hYFqgsmQ8HCL7xwjz3kgIeZegsw1N1Qw2cU4sxFTHlWD9HINQikdWZiqP5k4zNUP_O9vBmtCixVvk6AfHC6bWvdMVBPsDAd9YM18dmCU66zXrCqwXLls8V2CtL8gehe8Us4aG1Sau3omn1VEMt4AfmfpkCWbmE9A3M3COl5YmDAS0-UwChPK)**

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8ebf9fef11d647b3b1de4926dbacdc46&_e=jtDWSEjBMoWXO-ZkdILyWw7bvyKJezSkDK5QIWjEKjF1qFI5k8mx7FBbw1Cv3VB_-WUxE8CLDN2mGBm108PxczFzXZ6rIKETcT5fCCH9Nisz4GwxF9SPae8kChKxLJbX6poSNSY_6sAEVfLjp5jlp1LgCAoHCjyiF8iw9DBl_TubZQagX5pwn8HnCP472crJ1ruqipzx71CiELHVxjq6Hzcd6GqPHscu1ouHuAvXcJYi9VurgBLQdoQ4JSvKLeph7c1kFNl6ml-6LxqFjdUosx_YLBmTb8r6NyKnXeUh3tszmVjcBRpNzEoicuNNXg0RHA7EK3ZKiH5F5DfOh8RTLOVg-DRQJOUAVa40y8rcdU7gWQxleqXxJT32VJ3YJh-NPKbumrHpe_Mi8gLzaVKODg4hbzLWR5tWmPzQF0aVYRY%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8ebf9fef11d647b3b1de4926dbacdc46&_e=jtDWSEjBMoWXO-ZkdILyWw7bvyKJezSkDK5QIWjEKjF1qFI5k8mx7FBbw1Cv3VB_-WUxE8CLDN2mGBm108PxczFzXZ6rIKETcT5fCCH9Nisz4GwxF9SPae8kChKxLJbX6poSNSY_6sAEVfLjp5jlp1LgCAoHCjyiF8iw9DBl_TubZQagX5pwn8HnCP472crJ1ruqipzx71CiELHVxjq6Hzcd6GqPHscu1ouHuAvXcJYi9VurgBLQdoQ4JSvKLephmuZg9ckv7nkTdjLOZabW_NNDC6VhbOGc3Mh3fI3_PlyDz0uCkCEDYtHEuFNJoCqDeOdRelijzjlir-T1f16peuXP5ks3dyji70Yq-CcA4C9WqsXanewwSKJiHjZeySQJ2edSaU91lfIu6NEDDxIQsZTKkqYE68dyMdOAcy2oBsA%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8ebf9fef11d647b3b1de4926dbacdc46&_e=jtDWSEjBMoWXO-ZkdILyWw7bvyKJezSkDK5QIWjEKjF1qFI5k8mx7FBbw1Cv3VB_-WUxE8CLDN2mGBm108PxczFzXZ6rIKETcT5fCCH9Nisz4GwxF9SPae8kChKxLJbX6poSNSY_6sAEVfLjp5jlp1LgCAoHCjyiF8iw9DBl_TubZQagX5pwn8HnCP472crJ1ruqipzx71CiELHVxjq6Hzcd6GqPHscu1ouHuAvXcJYi9VurgBLQdoQ4JSvKLeph-luPulxzQQp9Gwub4B237VYqPeRs0xR88oXFR-GUJGCfvLbYNE6pYE4OxxlMCPPmwepOe4Jygx3Cv95KqYeas1v0peD_X2g5bcl--0k9CwIK1zqD6kLww_GZchwE7z0bOKXpFsqZrE2rMSzpARbQxlhofR6ZorxUF5wq2NbAM9I%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 .

As Warren grandstands in Washington, our state is suffering. She's had her chance, and she's failed us!
