body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hey Peter,

Today marks the halfway point of September, leaving us with only two more
weeks until the next FEC end-of-quarter deadline. It’s the second-to-last
time we’ll file our fundraising numbers for everyone — including our
opponents like AIPAC — to see in 2024.

While we saw some wins and losses this primary season, we need to show
those on the far right and corporate-backed establishment that our work is
far from over, and we’re rebuilding the resources needed to recruit even
more diverse, young, working-class progressives to run for Congress and
challenge the status quo.

Deadlines like this are crucial for grassroots-powered organizations like
ours to show we have the support of regular, everyday people like YOU.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240915.k5lL29&refcode=em20240915-35992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35992%2E1203867%2EVTPF7N ]Can you help us reach our end-of-quarter fundraising goal of $150,000
by pitching in $5 now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240915.k5lL29&refcode=em20240915-35992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35992%2E1203867%2EVTPF7N ]Donate »

Contributions from people like you empowered us to help re-elect Squad
members Summer Lee, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, AOC, and Ayanna Pressley
this year. But, with the devastating losses of Jamaal Bowman and Cori
Bush, we need to regroup and start preparing for candidate recruitment so
we can rebuild the bloc.

As we’ve built power and seen the impact of the Squad in Congress over the
years, we’ve been able to narrow the spending gap between our
people-powered candidates and the Democratic establishment. Then, more
challenges came our way when right-wing lobby groups like AIPAC and their
super PACs, funded by GOP millionaires and billionaires, started flooding
more money than EVER before into our races to oust our progressive
incumbents. Big Tech and Crypto are following suit.

We do our best to match the seemingly unlimited resources of our opponents
with grassroots donations of $5, $17.88 (our average donation this year),
$50 or more from folks like you. We rely on your support 100% because we
don’t and we won’t take a cent from corporate PACs.

And we use your donations strategically: we do research and outreach to
recruit the next generation of leaders, help our candidates hire staff and
build their campaigns, set up field organizing operations, support media
strategies, and so much more.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240915.k5lL29&refcode=em20240915-35992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35992%2E1203867%2EVTPF7N ]We truly can’t do it without you,
Peter. So, with our next FEC
deadline rapidly approaching on September 30th, can you rush a
contribution of any amount to fuel our critical work in the days ahead?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240915.k5lL29&refcode=em20240915-35992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35992%2E1203867%2EVTPF7N ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

The stakes couldn’t be higher this election for climate action — and yes, we know we keep saying it, but it’s true: _Climate scientists are warning that we have less than five years left to seriously cut down on fossil fuels to avoid the worst of climate change._ So we’ll cut straight to the chase: We need volunteers — lots of volunteers — who are ready to roll up their sleeves and put in the work for our climate champions. Volunteers who believe that the climate crisis is the fight of our generation and are ready to throw down, whether that’s through phone banking, knocking on doors, or hosting a virtual house party. **[Are you ready to join the ranks of everyday heroes fighting for climate justice? We’re building a number of volunteer teams. Read on for more information on each of them, or click here to take the next step!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92878980/498603010/-907986478?refcode=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxZTk4NDNlLTg5NzMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0JvhfvDUmTUMZoWuYPqymeAnUQCsI3d8rakoe_bx4Ho=&emci=d333630d-eb71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)** **Here are some of the ways you can get involved:** 📞 **_Phone banking:_** Make calls to voters in key districts, sharing information about our climate champions and encouraging them to vote. Most phone banks will be remote, so it’s easy for you to participate from anywhere. 🚪 **_Canvassing:_** Get out in the community and go door-to-door in high-priority precincts within our targeted districts. If you join our canvassing team, a JanePAC team member will reach out to try to find canvassing opportunities with our candidates near you. 🗳️ **_Precinct Leadership:_** Take on a leadership role with additional responsibilities in our key California districts. The JanePAC team will provide you with a targeted list of voters you’ll be responsible for contacting and ensuring they have everything they need to vote for our climate champions! 🏠 **_House Parties:_** Host friends, family, and neighbors to discuss the importance of electing climate champions. This is a powerful way to recruit volunteers and small donors. Jane might even join a few! 📋 **_Tabling:_** Engage the public in high-traffic areas with signage and candidate materials. Spread the word about JanePAC’s mission and the importance of voting for climate champions. 📝 **_Special Projects:_** Support our team with various tasks, such as remote volunteer support, training, recruitment calls, data entry, and more. Every conversation you have, every voter you reach, brings us closer to victory in November. And don’t forget: these down-ballot races have major power over climate policy. It’s not just about Washington, D.C. — it’s about electing state legislators, city council members, and public utility board leaders who can make change happen now. **[So, are you in? Let’s show the fossil fuel giants what a real grassroots movement looks like. Click here to join the volunteer team and help us turn climate action from a pipe dream into reality.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92878981/498603011/-907986478?refcode=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxZTk4NDNlLTg5NzMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0JvhfvDUmTUMZoWuYPqymeAnUQCsI3d8rakoe_bx4Ho=&emci=d333630d-eb71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)** | [**JOIN THE TEAM**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92878982/498603012/-907986478?refcode=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxZTk4NDNlLTg5NzMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0JvhfvDUmTUMZoWuYPqymeAnUQCsI3d8rakoe_bx4Ho=&emci=d333630d-eb71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e1e9843e-8973-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)

https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Peter –
Today is the first day of Hispanic Heritage Month! I want to take a moment to celebrate the rich history, culture, and contributions of the Hispanic and Latino communities here in Colorado.
From September 15 - October 15, we honor the generations of Hispanic Americans who have shaped our state’s identity and whose influence is deeply woven into the fabric of our society. From the early settlers of Southern Colorado to the vibrant communities that thrive in every corner of our state today, Hispanic and Latino Coloradans have played a crucial role in building and enriching our diverse and dynamic state.
Throughout Hispanic Heritage Month, numerous events and celebrations will take place across Colorado—from cultural festivals and art exhibits to educational programs and community gatherings. I encourage you to participate in these events, support Hispanic-owned businesses, and learn more about the history and contributions of our Hispanic neighbors.
Let us continue to celebrate the rich diversity that makes Colorado so special, and work together to create a more inclusive and just society for everyone.
Thank you,
Jena Griswold

Opponents of voting rights' plan to jam the SAVE Act through with a budget extension is faltering. One more good push from us and we can end their pipe dreams of harming this year's elections through federal legislation once and for all.
Add your name today and tell Congress to table this disenfranchising legislation forever >> [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091524_1&amount=25]
Folks,
Opponents of voting rights in the U.S. House are attempting to pass the " Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act ," a last-minute bill requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. Never mind that it is already against federal law for non-citizens to vote.
This proposal is nothing more than a blatant voter suppression tactic aimed at disenfranchising vulnerable communities , particularly minorities and low-income voters, who may struggle to produce the necessary documentation. Vote suppressors are using the ongoing government shutdown negotiations as leverage to push this harmful legislation through Congress.
Voting rights experts have sounded the alarm on this bill, warning that it could lead to widespread disenfranchisement. The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice highlighted that proof-of-citizenship requirements disproportionately affect naturalized citizens , who may be wrongly removed from voter rolls due to outdated or incorrect data. This bill would make it significantly harder for these legal citizens to participate in our democracy, all under the guise of "election integrity."
Sign our petition now: Demand that Congress act now to stop this dangerous legislation! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
We cannot allow this attack on voting rights to go unchallenged .
Vice President Kamala Harris has made it clear that protecting the right to vote is a top priority for this administration. Meanwhile, opponents of voting rights are doing everything they can to undermine our electoral system by making it harder for people to vote.
By signing this petition, you're telling Congress to reject the SAVE Act and protect the voting rights of every American. We need to stand up against these voter suppression tactics and ensure that our democracy remains inclusive and fair.
Don't let opponents of voting rights succeed in their efforts to silence millions of voters. Add your name today >> [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=d0f8abc73b8a4e1fac4604923a27e07f&_e=5TiIddWP6rHAE4kOQw8Czxk72zg8TdE0s3x-TZRU-wPMJ7Llcec0VeQLMRFzvh-ifI3bTosiyPNH4vr56EYUrgedS1qBDTpHkyxVhDo-BOs5qAzEgybokzJ62PgyNAqKxGQCj773ADZNg8EF2KUeg_CyrR-BFDL7dKT7pl5Y5NX9KwPLBSnp5DvrW3z52WCPmetSoT35H7I8NGJKi5Q8yKXTpuy0--0bzQssDfroGSNYiuP5w4nR7IdIoZQiJ70bt1Fjq08FCtrHalERi5VEy_HtNRvAfQsTm3qVjoF1Q30hR39lojH02-AdOZKSd5wgjszXrVRskrnVI_wml0IPPwjpg-r8sd5uPPtKukjf-PzdHG4pT8sfWg2kXDhEDICcV3-Rvufp8Egk7ysxRMSCwhyhcQ95ZrbU-BrZEXBGJq0%3D)

The American Cornerstone Institute

#
Dear Friend,

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Despite the Supreme Court ruling in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Planned Parenthood continues to receive taxpayer funding, effectively subsidizing the intentional killing of preborn children. Since 2000, nearly $10.7 billion of taxpayers' money has funded their life-ending work.

Contrast this with the nearly 3,000 Pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide dedicated to supporting expectant mothers. Planned Parenthood only operates about 600 facilities and primarily offers one service: abortion. Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. Sign our petition before midnight to demand an end to this grave misuse of your taxes. **[https://www.liveaction.org/defund-planned-parenthood-petition/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=399bc1f396094403a733a5ae11f36a79&_e=tyJ2GdtmwVcbhQweoG6lQEF3jqv3DQIhKdLzvG4l-gap85zHQnGntiFLn0kdiJNVbRciKhfjeMOWCVDdQW-sK6Zg_LBKxjxwbJo8u36ShPYhtlqZzuoz9dIK663ZWlYGnVutzpKalBuJWTYLjr4XrOMY7fi5d7a7ikTLOxObUobwP73SKoFo6JCqk2OUy5yzhRfi450ObbvN2il013eb-Auu5U3Xr3T1i1cfTFUtlFHHfFZqROzWbxxbkKeb8moNPnneSNZRdfcaCz-P2_7tEsS_9hZBVgPvb76_NQ73jxoSpOMeeZGMeDEcUD4aEfhAQnHWAQvjZZZgInBwJdIZs62AfjHwvwDhkCpuyAYk7vHGl-uhA1q6M7z0Dx-lHeyIZMtaCmw8woyzU1PKkSOuXg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for standing with us for the protection of future generations!

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

subject: Campaign manager update

body:
We can’t celebrate for too long.
#
Sarah won a resounding victory on Tuesday to secure the Democratic nomination for Delaware’s open seat in Congress — but we can’t afford to celebrate for too long because our campaign is at a **severe** disadvantage. Let me explain:
Unlike other campaigns, which have _months_ to build their general election campaigns, our primary election was one of the _latest_ in the country. **That means we’re starting from scratch to build a campaign that can win in November, and we have fewer than 8 weeks left to do it.**
[**That’s why we need all of Sarah’s supporters to dig deep and pitch in today. Can Sarah count on you?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240915-1?refcode=em20240915-1-1210&amount=5&refcode2=1210_21716_cLZ_XO&akid=1210%2E21716%2EcLZ_XO)
While it’s true that a dollar goes a long way in Delaware, we are facing another hurdle: TV advertising. **To reach undecided voters, we have to reserve airtime in the crowded Philadelphia media market — one of the most expensive in the country!**
TV ads are one of our largest expenses, and if we don’t secure our spots soon, there won’t be any spaces left to air Sarah’s ads!
**And to make things even more urgent, we’re quickly approaching our final end-of-quarter deadline on September 30.** Our opponent, the media, and the fringe right will sift through our numbers to decide whether they’ll pour in money to defeat Sarah in the final weeks of this race.
**So, we set a goal to raise $18,000 in email donations by midnight tonight.**
[**Your contribution will help us reserve critical TV ads and build a campaign that can win in November. Can you pitch in $5 or anything you can spare today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240915-1?refcode=em20240915-1-1210&amount=5&refcode2=1210_21716_cLZ_XO&akid=1210%2E21716%2EcLZ_XO)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240915-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240915-1-1210&refcode2=1210_21716_cLZ_XO&akid=1210%2E21716%2EcLZ_XO)**
This isn’t just about meeting a fundraising goal. It’s about making sure Sarah’s message about issues we care about — from affordable health care and housing to paid family and medical leave — reaches every voter in Delaware.
Thank you for standing with us!
Michaela
Campaign Manager
Sarah McBride for Congress

clean_body: | | | | I’m writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope. | | | | | | Dear Fellow Conservative, | | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope. Actually, in my case, it's a slippery slide. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" male swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit. And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me. | | | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide. It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare." Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women." It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word." Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot." Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it. God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that. Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... I don't want you looking back with regret wishing you had done something when you still had a chance. Your chance is right now -- and right by my side. Maybe you're thinking like so many, "Riley, adults are free to do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents." I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, "No." > But parents in MD had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a "girl." >> Parents in Vermont are seeing their foster care licenses revoked because they admit they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery. >> Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them. >> And Illinois is considering a bill that would change the definition of "child abuse" to include parents who oppose puberty blocking drugs and sex change operations. The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide. And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty. With the help of patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them. And the Center for American Liberty is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach. #1. They're fighting radical schools. I know it may sound crazy to you but in today's taxpayer-funded schools, teachers and counselors encourage young children to socially "transition" at school and then facilitate the "transition" by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex. And they keep it all a secret from parents! The Center for American Liberty is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win! , you're making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals! #2. They're fighting radical doctors. There are doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender "care." They use their "expertise" to convince even conservative parents that if they oppose "transition," their child will commit suicide. Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children's healthy breasts and other parts. Maybe you've seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the Center for American Liberty is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15. , you're helping Chloe and the Center for American Liberty make sure this never happens to another child! #3. They're fighting for your right to speak out against this evil. Fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the Center for American Liberty's specialties and they've notched plenty of victories in this space. Their next one is going to be fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA. This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women's bathing suit was in the women's locker room "helping" two little girls get ready to use the bathroom. And she was the one punished! , you're helping the Center for American Liberty protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you. Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in. And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... It will be my honor to send you my new book Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind as my free gift Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you. Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18 I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours. Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too. Sincerely, | | Riley Gaines | | | P.S. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the Center for American Liberty's work, Please hurry. It's getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don't want you to look back a year from now and say, "I wish I had done something when I had the chance." | | | | | | | ---|---|--- The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. © The Center for American Liberty | PO Box 200942, Pittsburgh, PA 15251 | |

Or contact your healthcare provider directly. **If you have insurance through a private insurer or Medicare or Medicaid, your vaccines will likely be covered at no cost to you.** **Unfortunately, the federal Bridge Access Program that provided free vaccines to uninsured adults just ended in August** , leaving the most vulnerable communities behind. For the 25 million U.S. residents without health insurance, the out-of-pocket cost for these vaccines could be between $100 and $200. **If you’re uninsured or underinsured, you can find where you may be able to get a free COVID vaccine by**[**checking with your local public health department**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMcirV_iXjn6EYhBQcqm0UTvPPB03mbR0dXOkOD503OQJdZ_UrMtuBKFURa_rSzBcnVDPPc4uzcwqpojkuj9wyKz2z-ntP0-cnRRylEDhCy6mtmfChLIlcLtLhW4d88_awbR0yeUOochhJSj1sPSKQoda-hlHRnBD-taNY_gUPzMd74RiMaHhY7ZgvtVwmu1VSlfFIbL-Ac8i2x2nkwtJBv22bUwhYfkU52ssBxTDWL27B9KNcuOXPN6ZNaLsfZI7MQe8pxm6oglGIWfHivP8iB6Lb-WQ4ocGRvq7ykHQuVjh-Uhs4_8g0xpSSLmqTTIjiA/49s/YqPVBq9SSgaMhzfgV8yVVQ/h3/h001.5iammpOGrfVlmMIr09-QjyPiXHFfMNEjyqMp_qRVbjQ)**.** Let them know that you do not have health insurance. In Michigan, our state’s Adult Vaccine Program has received thousands of doses to provide for free or reduced cost at local health departments and Tribal health centers. **Uninsured children aged 18 and younger can still get COVID-19 vaccines and other vaccines for free through the federal Vaccines for Children Program.** Please check with your child’s doctor’s office or use the above link to find your local health department. While staying up-to-date with the latest vaccines helps to lower the chances of infection and reduce the risk of developing long COVID, experts recommend using multiple layers of protection to keep ourselves and our communities safe. People can be contagious without having symptoms, so testing regularly also helps prevent spread. **Keep an eye out toward the end of this month: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services will again ship up to four free COVID-19 tests per household, which you’ll be able to order online.** If you do test positive for COVID-19, you can reduce the risk of developing long COVID by resting as much as possible and checking with your healthcare provider about getting a prescription for Paxlovid. Gathering outdoors is another way to reduce risk. When indoors, we can reduce the amount of time the virus stays in the air by filtering or ventilating indoor air by using air purifiers and opening windows. Spread by people’s breath, COVID is an airborne virus that lingers in the air like smoke, which is why wearing well-fitting masks is another important layer of protection. I promise to continue fighting in Congress for a stronger social safety net, including more federal funding for COVID-19 protections, lower prescription prices, an end to medical debt, and free healthcare for all. Always serving you, Rashida

I’ll admit it, Peter – it took me a bit of time to figure out what exactly my why was. Then, almost all at once, I realized I have been following my why my whole life. From volunteering at my sons’ school, joining the school governance committee, running for Orange County Commissioner, then for State House and now ending up in Congress — my career in public service has been somewhat unconventional. We're asking for a very specific amount - just $15. Why $15? Because that's the number of counties in Arizona, and we want to show that we have support from every single one of them. By giving $15, you'll be directly contributing to our efforts to engage voters, expand our base, and secure victories all across the state.
Arizona will be the nation's top battleground state in 2024. We are just four seats away from turning the state legislature blue, and only five seats stand between us and a Democratic majority in the House. **Arizona's next senator could be the difference-maker in expanding or losing our Senate majority.**
Our approach to party building and increasing long-term capacity is centered around building relationships with communities of color and developing the leaders of tomorrow. We know that we cannot continue to elect Democrats without expanding our base and inviting more Arizonans into our "big tent." Specifically, we need to ensure that Latino, Indigenous, and Black Arizonans are no longer overlooked or underinvested in. They are key components of our winning coalition.
In 2020, the Biden-Harris ticket won Arizona by just 0.3%. In 2022, Governor Katie Hobbs won by just 0.7%. These close margins show just how **_critical_** it is for every voter to cast their ballot early or show up on Election Day. We can't afford to leave anything to chance.
We’re supporting a robust volunteer training program that equips committed organizers with the skills needed to operate in a battleground state. We know that our success is impossible without the ability to recruit and retain both staff and volunteers over the long term.
_By building a sustainable bench of individuals who are ready to carry out the work, we can be fully prepared for the increased demands when candidate campaigns and national committees arrive in Arizona._

Today, **[I need your help fighting back](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxcjzGPnDAQhX_N0IHMGNtQuEiCSBElbZQqMrZhfWIW1tiH9t-fQKsrrvT7Pj3PM7QtYXpqUN8B8RbcDojAvwHi499BMb_Rr5-l-e3-lg_5h8RJ8QcgpufmP9VXS-XJhOVMVV84zSfHmsLrWqFssBWsLW6aKeld19amYQbHyataNXKqJ65U21rFi6CRYcO6WtQdSsErribBW8OEFSOzXQsNu_6pDPkYrKn3dJgY15Uqu1Kx6FtK234dNgAOu7c5-srcvVvTaQAOSxh9TM9yziY6wGGlubRrvicf9xxSSWN5ecCHnOj_vuZoPfD-iwcoT0zehUwXfiXJx_N9RHwF1tBmwnwH3tMIKA2dLcB7wYqo3XaEZQm7VNCw-dp2LnnX-BEAAP__cVmC4g). **

**[I'm extremely grateful for any amount you can donate.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxcjzGPnDAQhX_N0IHMGNtQuEiCSBElbZQqMrZhfWIW1tiH9t-fQKsrrvT7Pj3PM7QtYXpqUN8B8RbcDojAvwHi499BMb_Rr5-l-e3-lg_5h8RJ8QcgpufmP9VXS-XJhOVMVV84zSfHmsLrWqFssBWsLW6aKeld19amYQbHyataNXKqJ65U21rFi6CRYcO6WtQdSsErribBW8OEFSOzXQsNu_6pDPkYrKn3dJgY15Uqu1Kx6FtK234dNgAOu7c5-srcvVvTaQAOSxh9TM9yziY6wGGlubRrvicf9xxSSWN5ecCHnOj_vuZoPfD-iwcoT0zehUwXfiXJx_N9RHwF1tBmwnwH3tMIKA2dLcB7wYqo3XaEZQm7VNCw-dp2LnnX-BEAAP__cVmC4g)**

I didn’t make this decision to countersue lightly.

Project Veritas’ leaders have gone on air to claim I suffer from Aspergers and narcissism, calling me “Mr. Aspergers Narcissist," they have made unmistakable false claims that I'm "totally drug addicted,” among many other outrageous and slanderous comments.

I‘ve had a girlfriend harassed, personal text messages released, and even **had my medical records leaked**.

Now, I have been attacked for nearly two decades by the Left. I can take a punch. I can get knocked down and get back up. But I admit that the systematic attacks by **Project Veritas’ leaders knocked me to the floor like nothing has in my life**.

Betrayal is an understatement. Public humiliation by men you trusted as brothers offers a new type of pain that carves itself into your soul.

**I survived by throwing myself into my work with OMG**. And you’ve seen those results.

But even that has been challenging due to the bald-faced lies endlessly repeated by these folks I trusted.

Donors questioned me, prospective business partners shunned me, and **our enemies on the Left just sat back and took notes to use against me in the future.**

If it were not for help from men and women like you who maintained their faith in me, I'm not sure where I would be today.

**I thank God for your ongoing support.**

And I need you to **[step up again to finally put this matter behind me](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxcjzGPnDAQhX_N0IHMGNtQuEiCSBElbZQqMrZhfWIW1tiH9t-fQKsrrvT7Pj3PM7QtYXpqUN8B8RbcDojAvwHi499BMb_Rr5-l-e3-lg_5h8RJ8QcgpufmP9VXS-XJhOVMVV84zSfHmsLrWqFssBWsLW6aKeld19amYQbHyataNXKqJ65U21rFi6CRYcO6WtQdSsErribBW8OEFSOzXQsNu_6pDPkYrKn3dJgY15Uqu1Kx6FtK234dNgAOu7c5-srcvVvTaQAOSxh9TM9yziY6wGGlubRrvicf9xxSSWN5ecCHnOj_vuZoPfD-iwcoT0zehUwXfiXJx_N9RHwF1tBmwnwH3tMIKA2dLcB7wYqo3XaEZQm7VNCw-dp2LnnX-BEAAP__cVmC4g).**

My attorneys estimate Project Veritas' lawsuit against me and my counterclaim, which would allow me to recover attorney's fees, will cost another $228,000. And that's if everything goes as planned.

**But I must come up with $74,019 within the next 2 days.**

Will you help? **[Any amount you can donate will help knock down that large amount.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxcjzGPnDAQhX_N0IHMGNtQuEiCSBElbZQqMrZhfWIW1tiH9t-fQKsrrvT7Pj3PM7QtYXpqUN8B8RbcDojAvwHi499BMb_Rr5-l-e3-lg_5h8RJ8QcgpufmP9VXS-XJhOVMVV84zSfHmsLrWqFssBWsLW6aKeld19amYQbHyataNXKqJ65U21rFi6CRYcO6WtQdSsErribBW8OEFSOzXQsNu_6pDPkYrKn3dJgY15Uqu1Kx6FtK234dNgAOu7c5-srcvVvTaQAOSxh9TM9yziY6wGGlubRrvicf9xxSSWN5ecCHnOj_vuZoPfD-iwcoT0zehUwXfiXJx_N9RHwF1tBmwnwH3tMIKA2dLcB7wYqo3XaEZQm7VNCw-dp2LnnX-BEAAP__cVmC4g)**

This isn't about grudges or infighting.

It is far larger than that, and when we beat this and turn the tables, it will shut down future attempts to take me down.

I can’t prove it yet, but I don’t believe in coincidences. My ousting from Project Veritas came right after I released the biggest story of my life about COVID-19's manipulation by one of the world's largest drug makers, Pfizer.

Winning this will send a clear message that I am not alone. I have you by my side and am eternally grateful for your loyalty.

Thank you again. | | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. clean_body: I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter – and she saw what I looked like before I was injured in Afghanistan. | | | | | | | | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. And I’d be honored beyond explanation to receive your support in my mission to continue my service to America as the next United States Senator from Nevada. Duty First, Captain Sam Brown | | Sam Brown is a retired member of the U.S. Army. body:

Friends,
A couple weeks ago I told you about Jim Jordan’s latest stunt – targeting the daughter of the judge in Trump’s finance fraud AKA pornstar hush money case!
Here’s a quick recap: Judge Merchan’s daughter is a minority partner in a political consulting firm. Trump lied and claimed that this was proof that the judge was biased against him and had political motivations (???) when a jury found him guilty on 34 felony counts.
So OF COURSE Trump’s faithful lapdog, Jim Jordan, jumped into action as chair of the House Judiciary committee and issued a subpoena to the company to testify before another one of his infamous witch hunts.
But this week we learned that Authentic Campaigns CEO Mike Nellis is officially fighting back!
In a SCATHING letter to Jim Jordan, Nellis’ attorneys state that: “This subpoena serves no legitimate legislative purpose—making it invalid, unconstitutional, and unenforceable.”
This is how Jim Jordan is spending his time instead of serving the people of this country, and it’s why our campaign to defeat him is on FIRE.
We’ve already raised nearly $1.6M and we’re almost halfway to our goal of raising $1M more in September. I need you to pitch in $25 right now to help me rush a new ad out to voters about Jordan’s phony show trials. Besides, he’s been dodging his own congressional subpoena for over 800 days (going on 900 now!).
Either Jim Jordan thinks the House Judiciary Committee is a joke or a personal weapon to serve the whims of Donald Trump. Either way, it makes him incredibly dangerous.
The American people deserve leaders who don’t play games with people’s lives or treat our justice system like a toy. That’s why we are going to DEFEAT Jim Jordan this November.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

subject: Josh Hawley really thinks he's some kind of tough guy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
You just can't make this stuff up, Peter.
#

Peter,

Today marks the beginning of my favorite time of year–**Hispanic Heritage Month!**

I am filled with pride and gratitude for the incredible contributions our community has made to this country. From our culture to our work ethic, the Hispanic and Latino communities have been at the heart of America’s success story for generations.

As the daughter of Mexican immigrants who worked tirelessly to support their seven children, **I know firsthand the strength, determination, and resilience that defines our community. It’s because of them that I fight for working families.**

It’s been a difficult few years, and I know we’ve got work to do.

That’s why I’m working daily to deliver solutions to working families nationwide by improving **access to affordable healthcare, lowering costs, and strengthening labor rights.** I’m also committed to enacting comprehensive immigration reform with a path to citizenship to ensure families stay together.

I couldn’t be more grateful for the Latino community that continues to make America thrive.

From me to you, Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! ¡Feliz Mes de la Herencia Hispana!

Linda **💙**

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---

This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

Some day we won't have to say this anymore, but the reality is that there are critical elections across the country this fall , with the future of voting rights, abortion, and more in the balance.
Opponents of voting rights have long worked behind the scenes to make it more difficult to vote . The MAGA movement is pushing hard to bring back the bad old days with limited early voting, reduced voting hours, more restrictions on mail-in ballots, and anything else they can ram through if they take control.
The vote suppressors have spent years honing their playbook for important states and elections. They have the advantage over us in both money and time.
That's why we need your help to fuel GOTV efforts ahead of Election Day on November 5th. We're projecting a need to raise $50,000 for our Voter Mobilization Fund immediately .

And I’m standing up for reproductive rights.
|
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92886838/498628500/-1428124004?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_240915_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODQ5MTdhOS1hOTczLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eXK2eLesZyAp6KX1dYE0FdBi1DsKybbqFTBXKhst0A8=) Team,

**I’m an OB-GYN. I’m also a state representative here in Ohio.** I know firsthand how incredibly important it is that patients have the right to make their own health care choices. So in a moment, I’m going to ask you to [_**chip in to flip the Ohio Supreme Court**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92886839/498628501/-1500356530?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_240915_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODQ5MTdhOS1hOTczLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eXK2eLesZyAp6KX1dYE0FdBi1DsKybbqFTBXKhst0A8=) – but first I want to tell you a little more about why doing so is so critical for reproductive freedom.

Last year – in the wake of the Supreme Court’s dismantling of federal protections for abortion in _Dobbs_ – Ohio Democrats fought to pass Issue One in order to protect reproductive rights in the Ohio Constitution and prevent laws like the GOP’s extremist anti-abortion ban from taking effect.

**We won.** Because of that win, abortion _should_ be accessible in Ohio. **But that’s not actually the case.**

Ohio Republicans refused to accept that Ohioans overwhelmingly defeated their efforts to ban our reproductive healthcare, so they’ve been dragging out Issue 1 in the Republican-controlled Ohio Supreme Court every day since then.

**If we fail to flip the court in November, we’re at risk of living under an extremist abortion ban here in Ohio again despite having it enshrined in the Constitution. As a physician I have experienced those consequences when trying to care for patients who need abortions.**

When the first GOP ban was in effect, physicians and patients weren’t sure what options they had. This led to a lot of confusion, and to patients being sent out of state for care – including a ten year old who needed abortion care. There were women in hospitals facing life-threatening situations, and doctors like myself and my colleagues were faced with the prospect of losing their patient or their license.

Data shows that states where abortion is banned or restricted have higher maternal mortality and infant death rates than ones where health care isn’t restricted by politicians.

**We need to flip the Ohio Supreme Court to protect reproductive health care.** I’m working every day to care for Ohio women and families. And the best prescription I can write is for us to elect Justice Michael Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes – the candidates who will support the Constitutional amendment which puts reproductive decisions back in the hands of physicians and patients, without interference from the government or politicians with no medical experience or background.

But time is running out before Election Day, and it’s all hands on deck. So I’m asking, right now: [_**Will you pitch in $5 to help support the fight for reproductive healthcare and elect a pro-choice majority to the Ohio Supreme Court that will stand up for our healthcare access and our fundamental rights?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92886840/498628503/-1500356530?amount=5&refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_somani_240915_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODQ5MTdhOS1hOTczLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eXK2eLesZyAp6KX1dYE0FdBi1DsKybbqFTBXKhst0A8=)

Thank you for standing up with me in this important fight.

Dr. Anita Somani
OB-GYN

We won. Because of that win, abortion should be accessible in Ohio. But that’s not actually the case. Ohio Republicans refused to accept that Ohioans overwhelmingly defeated their efforts to ban our reproductive healthcare, so they’ve been dragging out Issue 1 in the Republican-controlled Ohio Supreme Court every day since then. If we fail to flip the court in November, we’re at risk of living under an extremist abortion ban here in Ohio again despite having it enshrined in the Constitution. When the first GOP ban was in effect, physicians and patients weren’t sure what options they had. This led to a lot of confusion, and to patients being sent out of state for care – including a ten year old who needed abortion care. There were women in hospitals facing life-threatening situations, and doctors like myself and my colleagues were faced with the prospect of losing their patient or their license. Data shows that states where abortion is banned or restricted have higher maternal mortality and infant death rates than ones where health care isn’t restricted by politicians. We need to flip the Ohio Supreme Court to protect reproductive health care. I’m working every day to care for Ohio women and families. Straight to the point, Peter: We’re just over seven weeks out from the election. Pennsylvania starts early voting tomorrow. And other states will follow suit. Time is short, but there is still enough time to motivate voters to turn out in some critical down-ballot races. While so much attention is paid to the presidential race _(ahem, debate)_ , many down ballot races are up in the air, and won by tiny margins that could be decided in the weeks to come. In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here – Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons – but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**

name: LinebergerforUSCongress
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – September 15th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

*Get Engaged*. *Stay engaged*. We are down to within the last 51 days
until the election is complete.
October 7th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this
election.
October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election
day!
*What we do now will make all of the difference in the quality of our lives
post-election*.

*A couple bigger / different events are coming up.* These are special
events to support and interact with our community.

*Football Fun with Ernest Lineberger for US Congress on Saturday, September
21st at UNT DATCU stadium*.
There is a special promotion where half of the football admission
price goes to LISD LEF
(Lewisville Independent School District Educational
Foundation).
We will host a tailgate before the game where we can have our signs
and share our message.
We have rented a 10X20 tent with tables and chairs that will be
set up and waiting for us.
We need to decide on what snacks, drinks and fun we want to
have at the tailgate.

* *** We are hoping to greet and share our message with a lot of game
goers during the tailgate 3 – 6 PM. We are hoping to have
lots of Dem’s there to help greet, share and boost our group numbers. ****
During the game we can sit together in the end zone seating.
We bought 50 T-shirts to help us stand out.
If you have a light blue shirt, wear it to blend with us if we
run out.
Here is the link for tickets: https://fevo-enterprise.com/event/LEF
Game time is 6 pm. 3 PM for tailgate start.
Mobilize link is:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/673008/
But don’t forget to buy the tickets with the other
link too.

*CCA (Christian Community Action)* does a lot of good work in the community
with food pantry, job training, counseling and more. They are having
a *fundraising
5K on Saturday, September 28th, in Old Town Lewisville*. We are planning
to support by showing up as a team to run (or to support) in our
‘Lineberger’ T-shirts (or other light blue shirt).
Our special Team 5k Sign up link is:
*https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd*
<https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Lewisville/hearts?raceRefCode=FcG0YSnd>
This includes a price break and admission to City
of Lewisville Western Days
The mobilize link is:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/675364/
(just for RSVP, use the first link to sign up/pay
for the event)

*Other Help needed*:

We’ve just ordered 100 new signs – exactly twice the size of a standard
yard sign (36 x 24).
These are smaller than the large 4’ x 6’ road signs from our
opponent, but they are easier to install and will give us some presence at
a reduced cost. Huge thanks to our sign team that is working the logistics
of road and polling station signs.
This will also free up more signs for home owners, we have
about 200 of those left.
Denton County has 54 early voting sites listed on votedenton.gov,
plus more in Cooke and Wise Counties.
Please consider being a sign volunteer in your area
to help place signs for early voting.
- This is a pretty low time commitment
with a strong benefit

*We have been ramping up our campaign in multimedia formats*.
- Digital Ads have started playing targeting in-district voters viewing
streaming television
- 97% have been watched all of the way through.
- Digital Ads will soon be going out on other digital programs
- We have a quarter page Ad in September’s ‘The Cross Timbers Gazette’
- advertising our campaign and our UNT / LISD football event on
9/21 at DATCU stadium
- We sent a targeted direct text to over 20,000 folks in our district and
near DATCU stadium
Even if they don’t come to the game, they will have seen my
name.
- We added content to our Tik Tok and YouTube accounts to help reach voters
- Tik Tok has 1570 followers, 3828 likes, one video has 5799
views (@ernestlineberger)
- YouTube; our top video has 511 views
(@LinebergerforUSCongress)
- In addition to ongoing Facebook, Instagram and X accounts, plus the
website.
We were awarded the endorsement from The Alliance for Retired Americans!
This in addition to our endorsement from the Texas AFL-CIO
union!

*All of this to try to reach our 300,000 vote win number.*
Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach
out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure
people that we are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make
it count*!

That said, I want to give a huge shout out to all of you who are already
working it! Thank you!
*Block Walkers* – We continue to have our Saturday morning
block walks with 10 or more working it with us.
Plus, several volunteers have asked for turf maps
to knock doors on their own schedule!
*Phone Bankers* – Our trained crew is working it on their own
schedule. Let us know if you want to join.
This is a great way to connect voters with our
message from the comfort of your home.
*Postcards* – We bought 10,000 and have handed out over 8,500
to be addressed and mailed so far.
Thank you so much for all you are doing to help in these
efforts!

With that in mind, here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to
the election.

*Tuesday, Sept 17th, *9 am, Denton County Commissioner Court in support of
LULAC presentation

*Tuesday, Sept 17th*, 11 am, Political Lens – podcast, I think this is a
recording session to be played later

*Tuesday, Sept 17th*, Wise County Faith Hub of TP USA Faith, 5 PM
Aurora Baptist Church, 201 Derting Rd, Aurora, TX
This may be a chance to reach some who typically do not vote
for Dem’s

*Wednesday, Sept 18th*, 6:30 pm, Flower Mound Area Dem’s meeting with
Ernest speaking

*Saturday, September 21st*, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Providence
Village, Precinct 1013 (weekly)
Meeting in Providence Village, TX will be provided when you
sign up
Link to RSVP and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/695319/

*Saturday, September 21st*, UNT vs. Wyoming Football game and Tailgate to
benefit LISD LEF
See Links to sign up in earlier paragraph, 3 pm Tailgate, 6 pm
game

*Sunday, September 22nd*, Visit another Church in district to better learn
our community (weekly)

*Sunday, September 22nd*, 4:30 – 8:30 PM, Frisco Dems GOTV Rally
Nack Theater, 6711 Oak St, Frisco, TX The doors will open at
4:30 PM for a meet and greet with local candidates. The official start time
of the event is 5:00 PM. Delia Parker-Mims and Sheena King will both speak,
then candidates (me included) will be given a few minutes each to talk to
the audience. Our keynote speaker will be Texas State Representative James
Talarico!

*Saturday, Sept 28th*, CCA 5K in Old Towne Lewisville (see earlier
paragraph for details and links)

*Saturday, Sept 28th*, 6 pm, Hope in Harmony – unity and love concert,
Creekview High School, 3201 Old Denton Rd.
www.mmconservatory.org

*Thursday, Oct 3rd*, 6:30 pm, Robson Ranch monthly meeting, Ernest to speak

LISD Candidate Forum date is being worked, Date TBD

*Sunday, Oct 6th*, 2 – 5 pm, Lantana Area Dem’s Election Kickoff,
Bartonville

*Friday, Oct 11th*, 10 – 11 am (event goes longer), Daily Bread Open House,
909 N Loop 288, Denton

*Saturday, Oct 12th*, 10 am – 5 pm, Cooke County Depot Days

*Sunday, Oct 13th*, 2 pm, Dems of 380 candidate event

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 5:30 – 8:30 pm, Prestonwood Candidate Forum and Mixer,
6801 W Park Blvd, Plano

*Monday, Oct 21st*, 7 am, Early Voting Begins!!! - Poll Greeting daily
(Will need lots of help to staff the major polling sites)

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking TBD

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help.
| Friend, Arizona is about 33% Latino. If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate.

I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. [If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a split donation of $10 with Voter Protection Project to help us win this race?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78274?t=6&akid=16851%2E878179%2EJ1LV_L) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78274?t=7&akid=16851%2E878179%2EJ1LV_L)
---
Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college.

But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard.

I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq.

I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate.

Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way.

To win, I need you to join me in this fight. With you, we can do it. Without you, I don’t have a shot.

[Please, can you afford to chip in $10 and help me become the first Latino Senator from Arizona? A Senator for ALL Arizonans, no matter what party they belong to or what country their family came from.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78274?t=8&akid=16851%2E878179%2EJ1LV_L)
